notes.title: Online PvP mode is now available
notes.content:
[b]Player versus player mode has just been added where players take on each other in 6 different arenas using the same control and weapon that you have been familiar with in the campaign.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31413542/dc07c4c964717feb5448fc0af11d59abef81f9a4.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Fun focused online Players versus Player battles with up to 9 players.
[*] Team up with friends locally on one machine to take on people online.
[*] Fight with 4 vehicles or on foot with 4 drivers
[*] Areans includes Japanese garden, harsh snow mountain, lush island beach, jungle military base, modern city runin.
[*] Surprise boss raid battles.
[*] Call in air strikes
[*] Bomb pick ups that do area damage.
[*] Light unlock progression
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31413542/6dcaa8c3e96bcfde02231448f2b96a51e8709261.jpg[/img]

Also included in this big update are lots of tweaks and improvement to the campaign:

[b]New game section[/b]: Player now control a massive battle cruiser right at the start of the game before the tank building section.

[b]Add dash ability to drivers.[/b] All drivers now have the ability to quickly dash/jump forward to increase survivability.
[b]Improve audio[/b]
Make most audio 3D positioned based for better immersion.

[b]Other fix and improvements[/b]
Refine some driver aim mechanic to make them easier to use.
Reduce item drop rate in arena
Fix the achievement of beating the final boss doesn't unlock on Steam
Tall buildings destruction animation looks better
Fix bug where Jeep's gatling gun in survival mode make enemy vehicle lose vital parts.
Fix possible exploit for accessing secret area in level 4
Improve little mech machine gun visual and audio effect
Reduce vehicle disappear problem
Reduce frame stuttering
Add Hint about how to avoid the last boss ram attack
[+] Add error message when player try to change vehicle outside checkpoint
Better tank dash animation
Add quick jump forward ability to drivers
Tweak vehicle cycling order
Lower rescue allied soldier hp
Make path to train tugging more challenging
Make rescuing arcade vehicle more interesting
Refine train crossing dead collision
Player vehicle now not slowed down by machine gun
Enemy firing sound effect is position based
Make bomber audio position based
Tweak  engine sound level
Fix bug where client can see host driver inside his tank
Fix desync in network where non host can't see the big machine
Rework the main menu logic
Fix bug where 2nd and 3rd player in multiplayer doesn't see each other movement

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31413542/f9a80973bb58be3ec732395757e93f59cabf3c3f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Announcing Tank Brawl 2 - Brutal brawl of steel monsters!
notes.content:
We are proud to announce that Tank Brawl 2 will be available later this year with very very ambitious features. We want to make the best tank shooter ever with 100 wow moments.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BrEz1zjG3oo
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23420180/5a7e8abd21a0cec4cce258a168e110c40cb4a0f9.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Free 3 vs 3 Team multiplayer battle[/b][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23420180/b0616debc1e52cdbea10cd38835c6cd38e0da436.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Combine vehicle and driver classes to make hundred different playable classes (Inspired by Titan Quest class system).[/b][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23420180/c3a2362ee9923bbf4d6ae1ec60e428f3cdda8167.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Drive Jeeps, Tanks, Giant Mechs or the brutal Mobile Rocket Launchers. Each with its own unique game-play mechanics.[/b][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23420180/0643067c91bde4e313de8fbb69cb2e8a999a2427.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]The most impressive tank destruction animation ever[/b][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23420180/d6fc3a732faa60450629a538007d9ddc89c9924b.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]A campaign with 100 wow moments, we will provide an in game counter of these moments to prove our promise.[/b][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23420180/b76d9621a55eaab773042c3bf1493470867de0b8.jpg[/img]

For more info and receive the free demo when it's out soon, visit our sites here:

[h1][b][url=www.tankbrawl2.com] www.tankbrawl2.com	[/url][/b][/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23420180/7086082bc3404acf503320a754530591df496b77.png[/img][h1][b][url=https://twitter.com/PhungGames] https://twitter.com/PhungGames	[/url][/b][/h1]
